title: Contrapunctus VII

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the subject in diminution, its notes halved, in the tenor.
☞ The soprano: the subject inverted, at its plain length.
☞ The alto: the answer inverted and in diminution.
☞ The bass: the answer inverted and in augmentation, notes doubled.
☞ The tenor: the subject in augmentation, under quicker statements.
☞ The alto: the subject inverted and in augmentation.
☞ The tenor: the subject right way up at its plain length, at last.
☞ The soprano: the subject in augmentation, over its own diminutions.
☞ The last entry: the answer in diminution in the tenor.

listenFor: the subject at three speeds at once, halved and doubled
